text: Be citizens from “the Belt and Road” countries with valid passport; be in good health and get good grades;Priority countries: Tanzania; Ethiopia; Italy; Russia; Pakistan; Indonesia; Vietnam; Thailand; Ghana; Nigeria;Abide by the laws and regulations of China as well as regulations of SWUFE;Applicants are not offered with any other Chinese scholarships for the program study at SWUFE; and shall apply for scholarship dicrectly and independently.Be a bachelor’s degree holder when applying for master’s degree program;Be a master’s degree holder when applying for doctoral degree program;Applicants who will graduate in 2025 shall obtain a national recognized corresponding diploma before enrollment. Otherwise, the admission qualification will be invalid.Master’s degree program: under the age of 35;Doctoral degree program: under the age of 40.Applicants whose native language is English, or can provide proof of studying in a 2-year or above degree program in which the medium of instruction is English, do not need to provide language certificate.Applicants whose native language is not English are required to provide official certificate/report of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 95 and above).
